title: Raku Firing Workshop
summary: A hands-on raku firing workshop where you bring up to four bisqued pieces, choose from Seatown's raku glazes, and fire your work, leaving with finished pieces the same day.
source_quote:
Raku Firing Workshop
Nathan Himes
Choose from a range of raku glazes to create effects from lustrous metallic to dramatic crackle.
explore dates learn more
evidence_sentence: The alternative firings page describes a raku firing workshop led by Nathan Himes where you glaze and fire your own bisque pieces.
evidence_quote: Experience the process of Raku in our hands-on workshop, where you glaze and fire your own bisque pieces using traditional methods.
